scope: Selected spatial examples; filter occurrences are not scientific validation or complete plugin coverage.

filters.purpose: Find inclusive minXYZ/maxXYZ cell indices per original positive FeatureId. Row 0 and absent labels retain UINT32_MAX minima and zero maxima.
Create six-component physical outer-cell-face bounds in micrometers. Observed background 0 has bounds; absent labels have NaNs. Preserve these raw results.
Select NumElements > 0. The measurements predecessor leaves row 0 at zero even though background cells exist; this mask excludes background and all unused positive labels.

Shift all six physical endpoints by half the supplied 0.25 micrometer spacing to form cell-interior query coordinates. The statistics filter floors both endpoints and clips to the image, recovering the intended half-open voxel interval without float32 edge-rounding loss. These query coordinates are not feature extents; raw bounds remain unchanged.
Set all six components of excluded rows to zero. These finite zero-size boxes contain no cells and safely replace raw NaNs/background bounds for statistics.

filters.pipeline: (02) Small IN100 Feature and Box Quality.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Count processed IQ per original FeatureId in 16 shared width-20 bins over [0,320). Background 0 is retained for inspection but excluded from grain reporting. Empty rows contain zero counts/ranges; no acceptance threshold is implied.

filters.pipeline: (02) Small IN100 Feature and Box Quality.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Summarize all processed-IQ cells in each valid physical bounding box, including other grains/background. Compute count, min, max, mean, and population standard deviation; BoxHasData gates interpretation. No feature-membership mask is applied.
